crossRefs.note: For Yahweh your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.
Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke…
All of Mount Sinai smoked, because Yahweh descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace…
When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.
He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”

translations.web: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
translations.bsb: Has a people ever heard the voice of God speaking out of the fire, as you have, and lived?
translations.kjv: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
translations.asv: Did ever a people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
